bullets.id: Emas memantul di awal pekan setelah Oktober terburuk sejak 2008. Investing.com mencatat spot naik 0,6% ke $3.900,05 pada sesi Asia, dan futures AS naik 0,2% ke $3.908,30. Pemicunya harga minyak yang turun dua sesi berturut-turut, yang meredakan sebagian kekhawatiran inflasi, serta pembeli yang masuk setelah emas jatuh 3,7% ke level terendah setahun pada Jumat.
bullets.en: Gold bounced at the start of the week after its worst October since 2008. Investing.com has spot up 0.6% to $3,900.05 in the Asian session and US futures up 0.2% to $3,908.30. The drivers: oil fell for a second session, easing some inflation worries, and bargain hunters returned after gold dropped 3.7% to a one-year low on Friday.

bullets.id: Pantulan ini belum mengubah gambaran bunga. Trading Economics menyebut pasar masih memperhitungkan peluang sekitar 75% kenaikan bunga Fed pada Desember, dengan yield obligasi AS sekitar 4,94% dan indeks dolar sekitar 101,9–102. Brent masih di sekitar $110 dan WTI sekitar $101. Emas sekitar 30,5% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dari Januari dan turun sekitar 5,7% dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: The bounce hasn’t changed the rate picture. Trading Economics says markets still price about a 75% chance of a Fed hike in December, with US yields around 4.94% and the dollar index around 101.9–102. Brent is still near $110 and WTI near $101. Gold is about 30.5% below its $5,608.35 January record and down about 5.7% over the month.

bullets.id: Level yang dipantau: resistance $4.000, sekitar 2,6% di atas harga saat ini, dan support di low pekan lalu $3.870,25, lalu $3.750. Skenario dasar Financefeeds $3.800–3.950. Agenda pekan ini: ISM manufaktur Senin, pemilu sela AS dan JOLTS Selasa, ADP dan ISM jasa Rabu, Bank of England Kamis, dan payroll Oktober Jumat. Ancaman Trump untuk kembali menyerang Iran setelah pemilu sela juga diawasi.
bullets.en: Levels in focus: resistance at $4,000, about 2.6% above the current price, and support at last week’s $3,870.25 low, then $3,750. Financefeeds’ base case is $3,800–3,950. This week: ISM manufacturing Monday, the US midterms and JOLTS Tuesday, ADP and ISM services Wednesday, the Bank of England Thursday and October payrolls Friday. Trump’s threats to resume strikes on Iran after the midterms are also watched.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram naik Rp5.000 ke Rp2.531.000 dan buyback naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.286.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp245.000 (sekitar 9,7%). Galeri24 tetap Rp2.443.000 (buyback Rp2.299.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS tetap Rp2.467.000 (buyback Rp2.274.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Harga jual Antam kini Rp88.000 di atas Galeri24 dan Rp64.000 di atas UBS.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp5,000 to Rp2,531,000 and buyback rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,286,000, narrowing the spread to Rp245,000 (about 9.7%). Galeri24 is unchanged at Rp2,443,000 (buyback Rp2,299,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS unchanged at Rp2,467,000 (buyback Rp2,274,000, spread about 7.8%). Antam’s selling price is now Rp88,000 above Galeri24’s and Rp64,000 above UBS’s.
